what: The Joker's calls on five games of 2026 weeks 3 and 4, as betting/state.json published them before each kickoff: the record the Pick'em Record grades for those games. Source, written once from git on 25 October 2026 and never regenerated by the job: betting/joker/joker.py publishes these calls for these games on every run, as it does 2026_w1_w2.json's.
why: Weeks 3 and 4 were played before the Joker's call was frozen at kickoff (betting/jobkit.py's freeze, a62e7fe, 9 October 2026). Until then every run scored every game of the season again, so these five moved after kickoff and the freeze then held the moved call as if it had been made before the game: four on the closing lines nflverse posted after the game had started (2026_03_LA_DEN at a5a4922, 00:50 UTC, its spread flipped from -1.5 to +1.5; 2026_04_IND_WAS at 8223c59, its closing moneylines and spread prices; 2026_04_JAX_CIN at d179bab; 2026_04_DET_CAR at cfb89a6, its spread from -3.5 to -4.5) and 2026_03_ATL_GB with the refit merged 3 hours 41 minutes after its kickoff (a64ed4e, #118). The owner's check of every number, 24-25 October 2026, found them; a walk over every first-parent commit of betting/state.json on main found these five of the 61 games of weeks 3 to 6 and no others (week 5's Thursday game, the one other played before the freeze, never moved). No pick changed, so the Joker's record and its line against Vegas stand as they were; the chances are the ones a reader saw before kickoff, and the ELO Model's re-picks on the Joker (elo/build.py, JOKER_FROM) stand on them.

src.published: the call betting/state.json carried in the last commit on main before the game's kickoff (`commit`, committed at `at`; `first_commit` where that same pick and chance had stood unbroken since an earlier commit: 2026_03_LA_DEN's 0.5093 and 2026_04_JAX_CIN's 0.5488 had each been published once before, at a64ed4e and 15da1cf, and moved off and back before it).

pHome: the model's chance that the home team wins, as published
